pr1654.impact: Only focused/release-ready aggregate guards change from always() to !cancelled(), plus source/controller controls. Workflow is included in POLICY_FILES, so its merge changes the trusted digest and old-policy receipts are not current release authority. It can reduce obsolete aggregate retention; it is not a prerequisite to run P1 source checks.

sourceWorkflow.sourceCheckout: exact pull_request.head.sha; full filtered checkout; source identity verification before/after commands
sourceWorkflow.excerpt:
name: Validate source for continuous main

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    # Metadata changes do not alter admission. Gate only source-head lifecycle
    # events so title, labels, milestones, and draft promotion cannot create
    # redundant queue work.
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: source-gates-${{ github.ref }}
  # Superseded PR heads cannot qualify the current source; do not queue behind them.
  # Release routing and manual runs keep their existing serialization.
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

# `release-ready` is the single required status on protected `main`. Do not add
# pull-request path filters above: a filtered workflow leaves a required check
# pending forever. Maintenance is classified in preflight and exits quickly.

jobs:
  preflight:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    outputs:
      runTests: ${{ steps.test_policy.outputs.runTests }}
      testMode: ${{ steps.test_policy.outputs.mode }}
      admission: ${{ steps.admission.outputs.mode }}
      focusedRequired: ${{ steps.admission.outputs.focusedRequired }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out the workflow's test policy
        uses: actions/checkout@fbc6f3992d24b796d5a048ff273f7fcc4a7b6c09 # v5
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
          path: .source-gate-automation
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml
            publishing/admission-binding.mjs
            publishing/admission-preflight.mjs
            publishing/focused-test-map.json
            publishing/focused-tests.mjs
            publishing/test-policy.json
            publishing/test-policy.mjs
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

classification.effect: All nonempty bounded source inventories receive maintenance classification; selected focused validation remains required, and source-only gates do not imply complete product-build or performance qualification.

mergeController.effect: Draft state stops merger independently of completed source checks. Dependencies and exact-head successful fresh admission remain required.

freshness.effect: Fresh base/head/policy observations and newly qualifying receipts are required; historical results cannot be relabeled.

verifiedRules.sourcePublication: The source workflow has contents:read and no Pages deployment/dispatch step. Appearance has no Pages/native qualification dispatch. Neither P1 commit changes native measurement tools, declarations or adapter pins.

testSelection.actualExecution: No local or remote tests executed by this audit; existing new controls remain unexecuted. Registered source/Appearance/Industrial/Company gates and eventual exact-head evidence still apply.

recommendedSequence: Compose lifecycle onto freshly rechecked main and open a draft source-qualification PR; leave all ready branches unchanged.
Admit MP3 as a separate draft after lifecycle composition is concrete; no runtime dependency on #1654, P0 or optional menu/authoring/backup work.
Retain useful current-policy source evidence and fix actual failures. Keep release/native dispatch held for its explicit reviewed windows.
After #1654 changes protected policy or main advances, reconcile and obtain current source/base/policy receipts before promotion and guarded merge.
Keep original trace observer collection before changing shared heap/overhead adapters; these two P1 branches do not alter that observer.
tradeoffs: New source jobs consume hosted queue capacity; no faster start/finish or fairness is inferred.
Opening and then repeatedly superseding heads can reproduce old aggregate cancellation retention until #1654 lands. Publish coherent reviewed drafts and avoid unnecessary head churn.
Source gates and normal feature CI are evidence for those exact sources; they do not establish physical-device, sustained performance or public P0 success.
